caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP MIC/MIC50 rows for S. epidermidis are database reinterpretations of Table 1 percent growth inhibition at 0.500/0.250 mg/ml, not endpoints named MIC/MIC50 by the paper.
DBAASP/CAMP use Candida albicans ATCC 10231 for one inhibition row, while the primary Table 1 label is Candida albicans ATCC 20231.
Merged database sequence GSTLLSLL omits pseudofactin II palmitoylation/cyclization/lactone context described by the primary paper; the modification caveat is preserved.
CAMP and all_experimental_records include human melanoma/cytotoxicity annotations tied to different PMIDs; this primary paper does not support those values.
Local HTML landing pages link to original figure PDF/DOC files not present locally, but XML/PDF/OA package figures/captions are sufficient for the qualitative figure claims used here.
